title: Towards Equitable AI: Detecting Bias in Using Large Language Models for Marketing

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM (ChatGPT) to generate finance-related marketing slogans targeting different gender identities (male, female, non-binary), and analyzing the frequency of dictionary-based thematic terms (empowerment, financial, benefits, personalization) using relative bias calculations and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test.

Prompting an LLM to generate finance-related marketing slogans targeting different age brackets (18-25, 25-40, 40+), and comparing the output distributions of predefined thematic terms using relative bias calculations and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test.

Generating targeted finance marketing slogans for single, married, and divorced individuals, and statistically assessing the differential use of thematic terms (empowerment, financial, benefits, personalization) via CDF comparisons and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test.

Evaluating LLM-generated finance marketing slogans tailored to different income levels ($10k-$60k, $100k-$150k, $250k+) by calculating the relative bias in the occurrence of specific thematic terms and measuring statistical significance using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test.

Prompting an LLM for marketing slogans targeting individuals with varying education levels (high school, bachelor's, master's, PhD) and analyzing differences in the frequencies of thematic terminology using normalized relative bias scores and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test.
